claims.evidence: Listed from the central directory of https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2025/05/PXD063561/LC-MS_files_exp2.zip via HTTP range request (zip64); only .raw members actually inside the archive are claimed, each exactly once. The PRIDE file list itself only shows the archive.

RAW header range-read from inside the zip (embedded text: Evosep One 30 samples per day, DDA_30 samples per day_HF_fastest.meth, Method of Q Exactive HF); overrides the PRIDE/paper statement that all runs used Q Exactive HF.
PRIDE sample protocol: high-energy collision-induced dissociation; paper Methods (read in full text) say the same.
PRIDE protocol and paper Methods: data-dependent mode; RAW header method.
Deposited mqpar_exp2.xml enzymes=Trypsin/P, 2 missed cleavages; digestion with trypsin (Promega) in PRIDE protocol.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M and Acetyl Protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: Deposited mqpar_exp2.xml and parameters.txt in the txt zip; matches PRIDE data processing protocol.
mainSearchTol in mqpar_exp2.xml (first search 20 ppm); PRIDE data processing protocol.
MaxQuant FTMS MatchTolerance 20 ppm in mqpar_exp2.xml (Orbitrap MS2, resolution 17,500 or 15,000 in RAW header); default value, not stated in prose.
Analytes are human albumin variants/fusions (MaxQuant fasta E:\Databases\Jeannette_L_variants.fasta, protein HSA entries); PRIDE lists human and mouse, mouse is not evident in the MS data.
No deposited mapping of runs to samples or replicates; each run treated as a separate unmapped sample, not as a replicate series.
Sample identity (albumin variant WT/LX/QMP/QMP-LX/fusion, with or without carboxypeptidase A) is not mapped to runs anywhere in the deposit or paper.
human template requires age/sex; recombinant protein so age=not available, sex=not applicable.

limitations: The deposit holds only archives (LC-MS_files_exp1.zip, LC-MS_files_exp2.zip, txt_exp1/2.zip) plus mqpar xml files; run names were read from the zip central directories, not from the PRIDE file list.

The deposit was split into -exp1 and -exp2 SDRFs because the RAW headers show different instruments (Q Exactive Plus + EASY-nLC vs Q Exactive HF + Evosep), different NCE, MaxQuant versions and fasta files. No single PXD063561.sdrf.tsv exists.

Which run is which protein sample (WT albumin, LX, QMP, QMP-LX, GLP-1/FIX/ACE2/scFv fusions) and whether it was exposed to carboxypeptidase A is NOT decodable from the deposit or the paper; no treatment or variant columns were added, and no factor value. MaxQuant evidence suggests exp1 runs are dominated by an scFv-HSA entry and exp2 by HSA_WT, but this was not used as annotation.

The paper and PRIDE state Q Exactive HF and MaxQuant 2.0.3.0 for the whole dataset; the exp1 RAW headers and parameters.txt (MaxQuant 1.6.1.0, 2018, different fasta) contradict this, so exp1 follows the deposited files.
Biological replicate is 1 for all rows only because no replicate structure is documented; technical replicate 1, fraction 1.
Fragment tolerance is the MaxQuant FTMS default (20 ppm), not stated in the paper prose.
PRIDE organism list includes Mus musculus; no mouse material is identifiable among the analysed MS runs, so it is not annotated.
Search files were read: mqpar_exp2.xml and parameters.txt; the exp1 MaxQuant fixed modification is read from the XML directly because the search-params tool omitted it.

SANDBOX RECOMMENDED (review PASS, but sample identity unresolved): MaxQuant experiment names are bare integers and the paper gives no run-to-file key for the albumin variants/carboxypeptidase A treatment, so rows cannot be distinguished biologically. exp2 was searched with MaxQuant 1.6.17.0 per its mqpar (paper/PRIDE say 2.0.3.0); fixed Carbamidomethyl was read directly from the exp2 mqpar.
